name: Ipomoea

project_scope.taxonomic_note: The source-pool row Ipomoea cordatotriloba var. cordatotriloba is taught inside canonical Ipomoea cordatotriloba rather than duplicated. Current Kew/POWO accepts I. cordatotriloba at species rank; ITIS/GRIN retain the autonym as an accepted/recognized infraspecific treatment. The project preserves the source name but uses one learner card. Distimake dissectus is intentionally outside this genus folder.

high_value_diagnostics: sepal length, shape, awns/tips, and pubescence

quick_comparison.hederacea: long 12–24 mm sepals with very long narrow curved/spreading tips
quick_comparison.cordatotriloba: pink-purple flower, ciliate ~8–12 mm sepals, variable cordate/3-lobed leaves; var. cordatotriloba source row is represented here
quick_comparison.lindheimeri: large blue-violet flower, palmately lobed hairy leaves, 18–30 mm sepals
quick_comparison.nil: very large blue/purple flower, large hairy cordate/3-lobed leaves
quick_comparison.lacunosa: small white flower, 11–14 mm acuminate sepals
quick_comparison.coccinea: small scarlet flower, sepals with subterminal awnlike projection
quick_comparison.batatas: cultivated/escaped sweet potato comparison; use swollen storage roots plus broader crop-context characters rather than treating it as a native morning-glory anchor

source_concept_status.learner_action: teach as source/infraspecific name inside I. cordatotriloba; no duplicate page

diagnostic_science_handoff.first_look: Measure corolla length and both outer and inner sepal lengths on a flowering specimen; inspect sepal tips and hairs before using leaf lobing or flower color.
diagnostic_science_handoff.triloba_vs_cordatotriloba: I. triloba usually has a 15–20 mm corolla and 5–8 mm sepals; I. cordatotriloba has a 25–40 mm corolla, 8–11 mm outer sepals, and 10–12 mm inner sepals. Values approach/overlap at the sepal boundary. Leaf lobing is variable in both.
diagnostic_science_handoff.hederacea_vs_nil: I. hederacea has elongated tapering sepals (15–25 mm in Go Botany). I. nil has overlapping leaf lobing and flower appearance; verify sepals on the actual specimen before deciding.
required_photos: outer and inner sepals with scale
diagnostic_science_handoff.boundary: Review only. Do not create canonical taxa or READY markers. Preserve existing learner admission and native-range states.
